audience: Authenticated Joe or Dell. Shared canonical facts, never caller-supplied identity or tenant.

query.q: Literal case-insensitive substring, at most 80 characters. Searches recorded names, ref, company, category, service coverage, city/state and address finding fields. Search never promotes an address to verified.
query.cursor: Opaque live keyset cursor, at most 2000 characters, scoped to view and exact query. Restart traversal after records change. Order is vendor UUID then contact UUID, with missing contacts first.

response.total: Exact candidate count matching view and query before cursor. Multiple exact contacts on one vendor are separate meeting candidates.
response.has_more: Whether a subsequent page exists in this snapshot
response.calendar: Own authenticated partner's calendar metadata. State is ready, empty, partial or unavailable. Includes observed_at, notes and source freshness when available. Does not return unrelated meetings. Missing, malformed or failed reads remain unavailable; calendar failures preserve the vendor page.
response.calendar_scheduling: calendar.scheduling returns maximal candidate openings of at least 30 minutes in the rolling next 24 hours, with explicit window bounds and minimum_duration_minutes. Each item contains start and end only. It may include overnight hours, makes no business-hour assumptions, and never confirms availability or books anything. State is ready, partial, empty, or unavailable; note always requires checking Outlook before booking. Every stored meeting, including all-day entries and unrelated meetings, blocks its stored interval. Overlapping and touching intervals merge. Missing/failed/stale/future/malformed/ambiguous/truncated calendar coverage suppresses candidates, including the conservative 100-item projection cap. Known unverified responses, group invites, and recurring coverage retain partial candidates alongside existing calendar notes. Outcome-review trimming does not suppress scheduling.

candidate.contact: Exact live person {id,name,email,phone,cell} or null. Missing email and phone do not prevent a suggestion.
candidate.category: Slug of the vendor_category row matched by coalesce(category_slug, category), the directory reader's key, or null. Legacy free text that is not a category slug is null and leaves the category requirement unmet.
candidate.service_coverage: Recorded vendor territory, distinct from office location
candidate.reason: Recorded vendor offers text. No inferred meeting benefit.
candidate.missing: Unmet requirements from named_contact, company, category, meeting_reason, verified_office, contact_permission, workable_vendor, in_market
candidate.research: {status,finding_id,observed_at,expires_on}. Status is not_researched, needs_review or office_verified. It describes the latest address finding, not an invented enrichment job.
candidate.possible_meetings: Upcoming or ongoing meetings in the next seven days whose organizer or attendee email exactly matches this contact email after trimming and case normalization. Returns the shared calendar projection fields including start, end, title, location, organizer, attendees, all_day, recurring, time_changed and schedule_conflict. No company, domain or name matching. Invitations do not prove attendance or a confirmed relationship. An empty list does not prove availability when calendar coverage is partial or unavailable.

identity: Uses v_vendor_assignment_context. Person vendors select themselves. Organization vendors select only existing live people whose org_id is that organization. An organization without a person remains in Research with contact null.
calendar_scope: Reads only calendar-agenda board_snapshot rows for the server-derived organization tenant and authenticated partner slug. Shared vendor facts do not grant access to another partner's calendar. Reuses the morning brief parser, seven-day horizon, overlap calculation, known-gap notes and 18-hour stale threshold. Calendar context does not change vendor readiness or keyset pagination.

office_evidence.store: Existing record-finding, subject_kind party, subject the exact contact's party ref, kind address. No new write path.
office_evidence.provenance: Existing source locator, observed_at not in the future, expires_on absent or not before the server current date. internal true and any proposes_correction field refuse readiness.
office_evidence.latest: Select the contact's newest address finding by observed_at then finding UUID before checking validity. A negative, expired, future, disputed, malformed or proposed-correction finding cannot revive an older verified office.
office_evidence.no_inheritance: City, service territory, another person or company office never establishes this person's office. Missing office remains null.

readiness: Suggested requires no missing requirements. Research is the inverse. Both remain searchable and paginated. A vendor whose disposition is not workable in vendor_disposition (parked, avoid, or any later not-workable slug) misses workable_vendor, and an out_of_market vendor misses in_market, so both stay in Research. Current contact holds, any live avoid vendor row and any suppressed or do_not_contact lead role on the vendor, contact or company prevent suggestions.
effects: Read-only. Does not change identities, source findings, relationship facts or approved client needs. Does not compose or send messages.
